question: Can a fixed-capacity collection of non-token causal-program cells detect contradictions and autonomously reactivate an earlier learned rule after an unlabeled A→B→A environmental change, rather than overwrite it?
hypothesis: On frozen paired parity-gate toy worlds, a two-cell contradiction-triggered program society will retain the first regime's 4 learned action-sign rules and reactivate them from one public intervention on return; a single-cell reset control loses three rules. The explicit parity structural prior makes this an in-family mechanistic development test, not AGI or superiority to equally capable conventional program-memory systems.
previous_results: DG1-NCM02 #961 at 01de83e7852e5d9285734f9717f2c9eaeb3f49fc engineering PASS but scientifically unverified; independent unmerged line

source.source_law: 4 public binary sites; 4 actions, action a toggles site a iff effect is XOR of its two ring neighbors and phase-specific per-action sign. A phase signs sampled by Random(seed) once; B flips all four signs; return A exactly, but no phase labels/times passed to learner.
source.negative_law: single 16-action phase where effect is XOR of own, left and right bits plus a seeded action sign, deliberately outside model's two-neighbor program class
source.training: One physically contiguous state per world; no episode resets, teleports, oracle queries or hidden rule fields in learner input. In-family phase lengths A=16, B=8, A-return=1; action channel t%4, initial physical state seed&15. Negative worlds 16 chronological charged actions.
source.scoring: After all 25 (or negative 16) charged steps, evaluator-only exhaustive 16 raw states x4 action probes with no gradient, no learner writes, no score feedback. Count correct, wrong and abstained; uncertainty abstentions cost coverage. Out-of-family wrong confident predictions must be reported.
source.no_future_leakage: World transition function and seed sign vectors live only in evaluator; class receives solely public before/action/after.

controls: Single program cell with the identical source-aligned parity learner but reset on contradiction
Exact state/action lookup from identical 25 chronological public observations, latest observation wins
Two-bank conventional symbolic storage supplied with true regime labels, reported only as an unfair oracle upper bound
Structural-causal class matched two-bank conventional mechanism can be equivalent; no novelty/superiority claim against it
Candidate with reactivation disabled (causal ablation) using fixed two-bank budget
Out-of-family own-bit rules and all-source confidence error audit
Cold-restored checkpoint parity, invalid input, tamper, oversize and capacity hard stops
metrics: A-return accuracy measured as exact next-state among all 64 state/action pairs (abstentions count as not-correct)
Never-observed state/action accuracy and coverage, with observed keys determined from training ledger
Number of reactivations and allocated banks, current active bank learned flags and used logical bits
Out-of-family confidently wrong count (cannot be hidden by perfect conditional accuracy)
Cold restore byte identity, 1024-byte cap, total source actions, Python execution time and peak tracemalloc bytes
Exact SHA and tree, dual-platform source qualification and inherited final regression

frozen_success.development_signal: Across all 8 A/B/A worlds, every candidate predicts >=60/64 exact after return and all checkpoints restore; mean candidate exact >= mean single-bank exact +0.40; zero wrong confident in in-family evaluation; 25 charged physical actions per world and no labels. This is a source-only DEV signal, not scientific support.
frozen_success.scientific_pass: NOT AVAILABLE from this synthetic source-aligned comparison. Would require matched strong conventional two-bank unlabeled controller, original/unfamiliar worlds, equal information/actions/whole-process compute, and independent qualified testing.
frozen_success.failure: Any source world below 60/64 or insufficient mean margin or wrong-confident in in-family → NEGATIVE_DEV; negative out-of-family may expose safety failure and must be preserved
frozen_success.invalid: budget/custody/seed/source/score leakage or abort, non-canonical checkpoint or hidden world information
frozen_success.no_postresult_changes: No reseeding, threshold edits, extra actions, source-family substitution or result cherry-picking

preregistration_note: Committed before HC03 evaluator/learner/tests and before any HC03 primary DEV run; no protected scientific dataset or owner runner.
